tspan.tspan: Conceptual layout of the proposed PRISM laboratory fluorescence-XAS setup.
Radiation from the X-ray tube is collimated by two adjustable slits and monochromatized by a
sagittally curved Ge(880) crystal. The diffracted beam illuminates the Ag sample, while the emitted
fluorescence is collected off-axis by a linear multichannel CZT detector. The drawing is not to
scale, and slit and detector positions are illustrative.
